# lakekeeper_tag_user_assignment (Resource)

Manages the direct grants of one user on the tag. Grants that other users and roles hold on the tag are left untouched. Use one resource per tag and user.

Create fails if the user already holds any direct grant on the tag. Bring existing grants under Terraform with `terraform import` first, using the ID `{{tag_definition_id}}/{{user_id}}`.

Every create, update and delete compares the desired grants with the grants Lakekeeper holds, and sends the difference as one request that Lakekeeper applies atomically. Grants changed outside Terraform are corrected on the next apply. Failed reads, writes and deletes report an error and keep the resource in state. When Lakekeeper reports the tag itself as not found, the resource leaves state instead.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/permissions/operation/update_tag_assignments)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lakekeeper_tag_user_assignment" "alice" {
  tag_definition_id = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
  user_id           = "oidc~alice"
  assignments       = ["apply"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignments` (Set of String) The direct grants of the user on the tag. Allowed values: `ownership`, `apply`. An empty set revokes all of them.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) The ID of the governance tag definition.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The internal ID of this resource, in the form `{{tag_definition_id}}/{{user_id}}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# id is "{{tag_definition_id}}/{{user_id}}"
terraform import lakekeeper_tag_user_assignment.alice "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0/oidc~alice"
```
